lines.en: The seething power of chaos was invading the capillaries throughout my body.
My Stories rebelled one after another against the encroaching power of chaos.
[The Story ‘One Who Opposes the Extraordinary’ dreams of a miracle.]
[The Story ‘Slayer of an Outer God’ resists your transformation!]
[The Giant Story ‘Demon Realm’s Spring’ protects you!]
Barely clinging to my fading consciousness, I staggered toward the Scripture.
Was it a side effect of becoming an Outer God? I heard something like voices from somewhere. It seemed my consciousness had fractured and [Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint] had activated on its own.
But this time, it was not just one person. The voices reached me simultaneously, as though I were sensing several people’s perspectives at once.
「……I knew.」
Yoo Joonghyuk.
「It was way too obvious from the start. I thought it might be him.」
Lee Jihye.
「If he didn’t tell us first, he must have had a reason.」
Shin Yoosung.
「A-Actually, I expected it too, you know? Dokja-hyung! Dokja-hyung!」
Lee Gilyoung.
「……Dokja-ssi?」
Jung Heewon.
What could I say to them, when they already understood everything without being told?
「What a powerful Sun Wukong…… Who could he be?」
……Lee Hyunsung.
I chuckled.
Right. Lee Hyunsung was better off not knowing.
I could feel my memories beginning to collapse.
Once the transformation was complete, they would scatter into the dust of the universe.
「Kim Dokja was afraid.」
The [Fourth Wall] would know.
All my bold declarations were a coward’s proclamations.
「After losing all my memories, would I really still be ‘me’?」
I had died many times, but I had never lost my memories wholesale.
What would become of the ‘me’ who remembered everything now?
「What truly frightened him was not death.」
Could I really retain all these emotions just by reading again?
[The Story ‘Life and Death Companions’ looks at you.]
[The Story ‘One Who Hunted the King of Disasters’ looks at you.]
[The Story ‘Giant’s Liberator’ looks at you.]
Could I truly experience again everything I had gone through while building these precious stories?
「And before Kim Dokja lay the Scripture.」
『Journey to the West Remake』.
That Scripture was the ‘Giant Story’ itself.
The moment I grasped it, this ‘Giant Story’ would belong to <Kim Dokja’s Company> and the Outer Gods.
「Kim Dokja reached toward the Scripture.」
With this, our 『Journey to the West』 would be complete.
Tssst, tssst……
That was when something strange happened.
[An anomaly in the scenario is delaying your transformation into an Outer God.]
……Delaying it?

The sparks around me rapidly intensified, and the constellations’ shouts grew distant. The flow of space and time was bending strangely. Probability was stirring with such force that goosebumps rose along my spine, sending a chill through me. As though the entire <Star Stream> were stirring.
Someone was intervening in the scenario through the distorted space.
[Great Dokkaebi ‘Heoju’ has manifested in the scenario!]
[Great Dokkaebi ‘Heoche’ has manifested in the scenario!]
[Great Dokkaebi ‘Halong’ has manifested in the scenario!]
[Great Dokkaebi ‘Haram’ has manifested in the scenario!]
[Great Dokkaebi ‘Haesol’ has manifested in the scenario!]
The Great Dokkaebis’ manifestation.
Tssssst!
My fingertips reaching toward the scriptures froze as though petrified.
This could not happen.
[You cannot have that story.]
Dokkaebis could not intervene in main scenarios.
No, they had provoked me indirectly even before now, but never had beings as high-ranking as Great Dokkaebis directly twisted a scenario.
Yet they had intervened, staking even their own probability.
[The <Star Stream> is in upheaval!]
The Great Dokkaebis were part of the <Star Stream> too.
Even those who oversaw the system could not escape the consequences of using probability abnormally.
Perhaps that was why fierce sparks flew from their bodies as well.
[The forgotten must remain forgotten.]
I thought I understood a little of why they were going this far.
If I took this Scripture and acquired the ‘Giant Story’.
【Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa】
【Ooooooooooooooooo……!】
The ‘Outer Gods’ they had always excluded from stories would be formally incorporated into a ‘Giant Story’.

Outer Gods were a power their system alone could not fully control. If beings of Outer God rank, rather than low- or intermediate-level [Old Ones], began indiscriminately joining scenarios, the <Star Stream> would descend into utter chaos.
Even so, I had to finish this.
[Stop.]
The Great Dokkaebis’ Status constricted my whole body like chains. My hand stopped a handspan short of the Scripture. But I did not panic.
Since the Great Dokkaebis had appeared in defiance of probability, another being would appear to balance the skewed scales.
Rrrrrrumble!
No sooner had I thought it than the sky began swirling.
A [Great Hole]. The being that appeared beyond it was looking down at me.
[Take the Scripture, ■■ Apostle.]
It was the Wenny King I had met in N'Gai's Forest.
Seeing the Wenny man, the Great Dokkaebis shouted in alarm.
[How dare you……!]
[Demon of the Horizon, what do you think you’re doing here!]
[There is no probability for your appearance in this scenario.]
The Wenny King sneered.
[The same goes for you lot.]
The Great Dokkaebis’ Status clashed with the Wenny King’s, and my bound body began moving again. Then my hand moved that last handspan.
[Your transformation into an Outer God resumes.]
The Wenny King smiled broadly.
[<Star Stream>, the worlds you erased will come.]
The moment my fingertips touched the Scripture, my consciousness faded amid a brilliant current.
I could vaguely sense what would happen next.
Looking back, I slowly closed my eyes.
「Now, all I could trust was……」
A scattering of light in the distant sky.
At least for that moment, even the Lords of Nine Stars and the Twenty-Eight Mansions could not help looking at that explosion.
[Every constellation of the nebula <Emperor> is shocked!]
Fleeing the Lords of Nine Stars’ attacks, Lee Gilyoung brought the dragon horse to a halt.
“……Shin Yoosung?”
Waking in the saddle, Shin Yoosung opened her eyes.
As soon as she regained consciousness, she looked toward the western sky with Lee Gilyoung.
Her heart pounded.
[Something’s wrong. Finish off the small fry quickly, and hurry—]
After hesitating briefly, the Lords of Nine Stars and <Emperor>’s Historical-grade constellations charged at Lee Gilyoung and Shin Yoosung again.
His eyes still fixed on the western sky, Lee Gilyoung spoke.
“I’ll break through. Go.”
He knew without anyone explaining.
The story they had been searching for was there.
“Go save Dokja-hyung!”
Kim Dokja was there.
Shin Yoosung felt it too.
Perhaps more keenly than anyone here.

The moment Lee Gilyoung leaped from the dragon horse and released his Status, Shin Yoosung spurred it on. Turning into a blue dragon, it sped across the river like a speedboat. In the distance, she smelled a Story she had missed.
She saw the starlight of the sponsor who had protected her for so long.
It had been shining so clearly…… Why had she not been certain?
Countless questions swirled through her mind.
Why was Kim Dokja here?
Why had he not revealed his identity to them?
Shin Yoosung could not know that much. Only
If she lost Kim Dokja there.
She felt she would never see him again.
Boom-boom-boom!
The dragon horse was hit by a beam-cannon blast from the Lords of Nine Stars. Shin Yoosung screamed and fell into the river.
There were beings who pulled her out.
【KimDokjaKimDokjaKimDokjaKimDokjaKimDokja】
【Usususususus】
Since when? The demons floating on the river were crossing it in a group.
Before she knew it, Shin Yoosung had climbed onto them. They rose like stepping stones to form a path.
【Savesavesavesavesavesave】
Running across those demons, Shin Yoosung realized.
「Ajusshi is there now for their sake.」
The moment she understood, something surged up within her.
She saw Kim Dokja’s Stories unraveling in the brilliant light.
Nobody needed to explain that he was in danger.
「Why does ajusshi always, all on his own.」
The first emotion to surge up was resentment.
Why did Kim Dokja not ask them for help?
「He must have had a reason he couldn’t.」
She knew that, but.
「He must have thought it was the best choice.」
Even so, some things were hard to accept.
It had been the same in the Dark Castle, and it had been the same in the Demon Realm. And then the Great War of Saints and Demons.
Their long series of scenarios had always been a history of Kim Dokja’s sacrifices.
「And so, this resentment was actually directed not at Kim Dokja, but at Shin Yoosung herself.」
A sorrow she understood because she was the incarnation of none other than Kim Dokja.
The pain she was feeling now was nothing compared to his resolve.
「Kim Dokja would surely say, “Yoosung, no sorrow is heavier than another.”」
Shin Yoosung did not agree.
Some sorrows were heavier than others.
The despair of someone risking their life to save another could not be the same as the grief of someone driven to despair by watching helplessly.
Ultimately, every person valued themselves most.
And Kim Dokja had always staked everything he had.
Then the river exploded before her.
<Emperor>’s constellations were falling, spilling Stories.
[Come, vanished stories!]
With a sound that thundered through the world, the scenery began changing.
[Great Holes] opened across the sky, and beings with unimaginable Status crossed through.
They were no longer ‘Outer Gods’.
[■?■?■■ joins in an ‘extra’ role!]
[■■?■ joins in an ‘extra’ role!]
They were the demons of Journey to the West.
(The final war over ownership of the Scripture.)
(A horde of dark demons (陰魔) was swarming in to adorn the final chapter of the long story.)
It looked as though the world were ending.
At the heart of that destruction, Kim Dokja walked among the demons with unfocused eyes.
Was she imagining it? At that moment, Kim Dokja no longer seemed to be Kim Dokja, but one of the demons.
‘I have to stop him.’

On the broken path of demons, Shin Yoosung looked down at her small hands. Hands she believed could accomplish things even more remarkable than adults could, and which had truly done so. Yet at that moment
Her hands felt like nothing more than a child’s.
The sky split and the earth was crushed. The Tongtian River overturned in its entirety, and living beings on the river died, spilling blood and Stories.
[Judge ‘Descendant of Sakyamuni’ looks at you.]
Along with that gaze, someone’s voice reached her.
[Yoosung, you have to do it.]
It was a voice she knew.
“Sangah-unnie?”
[At this rate, Dokja-ssi will pass the point of no return. You’re the only one who can stop him.]
There was no time to question how this was possible. Shin Yoosung asked what she needed to know first.
“How? What should I do?”
Yoo Sangah did not answer immediately.
Instead, like a Buddha presenting a koan, she said,
[Don’t forget your role.]
Shin Yoosung stared blankly at the sky for a moment, then looked toward Kim Dokja.
The golden band faintly shining on Sun Wukong’s head.
She looked down at her fist again. It was still a child’s fist. But it was also the fist of ‘Tang Sanzang’.
“……Can I do it?”
Her voice trembled at the end.
Kim Dokja’s figure, swaying in the distance.
[The Story ‘Demon King of Salvation’ continues its story.]
At last, the tears she had held back burst out.
“This could be what ajusshi wants.”
To that child, Yoo Sangah said,
[He is someone who was alone for a very long time.]
Kim Dokja (金獨子).
[Telling someone like that once or twice that they aren’t alone won’t change them overnight.]
She was the incarnation of that very Kim Dokja.
[You have to tell him, stay beside him, and reassure him.]
Crying, Shin Yoosung moved forward.
[Until he truly knows that he isn’t alone.]
Gathering all her Status, Shin Yoosung took a running start. Like Kim Dokja using [Way of the Wind], she ran across the river with all her strength.
Stepping on the gradually sinking surface, she shouted at the top of her lungs.
“Ajusshi!”
Kim Dokja was not listening. In the middle of the battle between demons and constellations, he was becoming a demon, gazing in her direction with empty eyes.
His body was changing. Kim Dokja was scattering.
“Don’t go! Please! I said don’t go!”
Watching her sponsor disappear before her eyes, Shin Yoosung screamed at the top of her lungs. It sounded more like a shriek than words. It was something words could not convey.
[A new Story germinates within you!]
Not everyone can use language in special ways, and that is precisely why Stories exist.
Words that cannot be conveyed become stories.
The golden letters of the Headband-Tightening Incantation (緊箍咒) shone as a Story.
「I won’t give up. Just as ajusshi saved me again and again—」
Amid the falling meteors, Shin Yoosung looked straight at her star and spoke.
「I will save you too.」
A roar rang out from the battlefield’s center. The surrounding air was changing.
The advancing ranks of demons and the descending constellations of <Emperor>.
Fei Hu followed those ranks with his eyes, then turned his gaze to the opponent blocking him.
“……You’re truly strong. Are there many incarnations like you in Korea?”
Jung Heewon was covered in wounds. But her Status remained intact, and her fighting spirit burned fiercely.
Fei Hu looked down at the cuts her steel sword had left across his chest and flank.

He was not fighting alone. He had Erlang Shen, Prince Nezha, and even his nebula’s support. Yet despite all that, they were failing to defeat a single incarnation who had descended as another Story chamber’s ‘Bull Demon King’.
“Cut the chatter and come at me.”
Watching Jung Heewon’s blazing eyes, Fei Hu shook his head.
“The fact we struggled this much against just one person is already our defeat.”
As though he had no intention of fighting further, he put away his weapon and looked toward the distant sky.
“And it seems this isn’t the real battlefield.”
With that, Fei Hu launched himself toward the scriptures, together with Erlang Shen and Prince Nezha.
Just as Jung Heewon hurried to react, a summoned ship took them aboard and sped away.
[‘Hour of Judgement’ has ended.]
……The timing had been dangerously close.
Had the fight continued a little longer, she would have been the one defeated.
Fei Hu, indeed.
Apparently, he was not <Emperor>’s exclusive incarnation for nothing.
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ anxiously watches the battlefield’s center.]
Archangel wings grew from both Jung Heewon’s shoulders.
Almost flying, she ran over the water.
‘……What on earth is going on?’
With separate battles raging everywhere, she could not tell where to run first.
Lee Jihye, facing <Emperor>’s ships. Yoo Joonghyuk, fighting the Twenty-Eight Mansions. Lee Gilyoung, confronting the Lords of Nine Stars……
Dozens of [Great Holes] were opening in the sky. The Outer Gods crossing through them turned into demons and waged war on the constellations.
And at the center.
“Yoosung!”
There was a girl reaching toward a star.
Shin Yoosung stared at <Emperor>’s constellations charging at her.
[The nebula <Emperor>’s Twelve Star Lords (元辰) descend!]
[The nebula <Emperor>’s Dragon Kings of the Four Seas (龍王) descend!]
(One by one, Sun Wukong’s nemeses were gathering.)
[It isn’t over yet!]
[As long as Sanzang doesn’t touch the Scripture!]
[Split our forces. One side, take the Scripture from him. The other, subdue Sanzang!]
Shin Yoosung clung to the mane of Chimera Dragon, now a blue dragon. Emperor’s main forces charged at her.
Kim Dokja was too far away.
[<Emperor>’s ‘Twelve Star Lords’ reveal their Status!]
Booooom!
Light exploded before her eyes.

Chimera Dragon curled around her to protect her. Searing heat shot through her body. A second and third explosion erupted in succession, and Chimera Dragon screamed. Gritting her teeth, Shin Yoosung pushed off its back and leaped.
[Your sponsor’s blessing affects you.]
[Your remarkable talent blooms!]
[You have independently grasped ‘Way of the Wind’!]
She did not know how it was possible.
Yet at that moment, Shin Yoosung was running across the river. The blessing of [Way of the Wind] burst from her toes. Golden ripples spread wherever her feet touched.
「Shin Yoosung ran like Kim Dokja.」
That was how her sponsor ran.
Blades, a mixture of swords and spears, flew through the air.
Three to the left, one to the right.
Two below.

Shin Yoosung narrowly dodged the blades. But the more she dodged, the fiercer the attacks became. Hundreds of blades swirled like a threatening storm. Like a monster opening a mouth filled with hundreds of teeth.
Before that monster, Shin Yoosung drew the dagger from inside her clothes.
「Shin Yoosung assessed the situation like Yoo Joonghyuk.」
Something he had once taught her.
[The Story ‘Supreme King’s Disciple’ begins its story!]
「“One day, you will become a ‘Beast Lord’. Countless monster species will reign beneath your feet.”」
「“But that doesn’t mean you can be friends with every monster.”」
The three years when Kim Dokja had been absent.
Yoo Joonghyuk had taught Shin Yoosung to hunt.
How to face large monster species. How to hunt those with tough hides, and how to kill those difficult to fight at close quarters.
「“When you have no choice but to kill, end its life without hesitation.”」
「“Otherwise, you’ll be the one who dies.”」
The moment she held her breath, she saw a gap among the blades.
The eye of the storm, where the wind stilled.
Releasing all her Status, Shin Yoosung threw her dagger into that gap.
Boom-boom-boom-boom!
The wind’s currents scattered, and the blades flying toward her dispersed all at once.
But she could not avoid every blade. Sword tips and spearheads grazing the child’s small body. Blood spurted from her shoulder.
「Shin Yoosung dropped flat like Lee Hyunsung.」
Lee Hyunsung’s face flashed through Shin Yoosung’s mind as she lay flat behind floating debris.
「“You hide like this. Never forget to identify the cover around you first.”」
The man who always wore an awkward smile as he moved his bear-like body into a prone position. And even Jung Heewon’s voice, adding something to Lee Hyunsung’s words.
「“When there are too many enemies, there might be nowhere to hide.”」
「“Hmm, you’re right.”」
The Dragon Kings of the Four Seas were controlling the river.
Sharp spears made of water assaulted Shin Yoosung from every side. The debris shattered one piece after another, until there was nowhere left on the river for her to hide.
「“Then use the enemies. Like this.”」
Han Sooyoung, speaking as she lifted the head of the prone Lee Hyunsung. Jung Heewon glaring at her, and Lee Gilyoung’s giggles.
Recalling it all, Shin Yoosung seized one of the incarnations attacking her and used them as a shield.
“Wh-What…… Aaaaargh!”
「Shin Yoosung became ruthless like Han Sooyoung.」
Discarding the wretchedly impaled incarnation body, she kept running.
[Cunning little brat.]
[Don’t let her get away!]
She was now much closer to Kim Dokja.
“Ajusshi!”
As though he had heard her, Kim Dokja stopped short.
Looking at those empty eyes, Shin Yoosung remembered Yoo Sangah’s words.
「“We’re sorry the world is like this.”」
She sees the companions gathering, one by one.

「“We’re sorry we hurt you. Sorry we’re helpless adults who have to rely on you. But I’ll promise you one thing. We’ll always be beside you. We’ll do everything we can so you don’t have to use these techniques.”」
Shin Yoosung remembers those words.
「“So you don’t forget who you are.”」
Swish!

A long spear blade grazed her cheek. She touched it unconsciously, and blood ran down. There was no one around to help her. Not Yoo Joonghyuk’s back protecting the companions, nor Jung Heewon’s sword she could always rely on.
Catching her off guard, a long arm shot out and seized Shin Yoosung by the collar. <Emperor>’s Twelve Star Lords were approaching her.
[……To think she really was a child.]
[They gave this role to a mere child?]
<Emperor>’s irresistible Status pressed down on her whole body.
Ordinarily, she could never have faced such an enemy. Running would have been natural; seeking her companions’ help, the best choice.
Even so, Shin Yoosung did not run.
[Your accumulated Stories cause an anomaly!]
Slowly blinking, she opened her eyes. Her wildly pounding heart calmed. A sharp, icy light streamed from both her eyes.
[The attribute evolution of incarnation ‘Shin Yoosung’ is imminent.]
[You have encountered a catalyst for attribute evolution!]
“I’m not just a child.”
[……What?]
Shin Yoosung seized the Star Lord’s left hand. The Star Lord’s arm trembled under the strength of the child’s grip.
“My name is Shin Yoosung.”
[You have acquired a Legendary-grade attribute.]
[You have become a ‘Beast Lord’.]
“Shin Yoosung, of <Kim Dokja’s Company>.”
Pure-white Status, white as snow, swept over the river.
When the Star Lords screamed and stepped back, a girl wearing a white coat stood before them.
[Beast King’s Sensitivity].
The strongest defensive skill of the ‘Beast Lord’, used by the Shin Yoosung of the 41st round.
The river overflowed, and all the demons and monsters of every species living within it leaped out at once.
Groooooooar!
As though worshipping their king.
[Damn…… Where did these things……!]
[Attack! Kill those beasts first!]
<Emperor>’s constellations opened fire.
The monsters that rose up protected her.
“Chimera Dragon!”
Graaaaaaah—!
Under the influence of her attribute, [Chimera Dragon] grew even larger. Churning through the river like an imoogi, it swallowed Star Lords and roared. Torn by its sharp fangs, they shouted.
[That damned lizard……!]
Ignoring them, Shin Yoosung ran.
【Ooooooooooooo】
【YoosungYoosungYoosungYoosungYoosungYoosung】
The demons opened a path for her.
Now, the star was right before her.
“Ajusshi!”
She calls out to Kim Dokja.
But as though he could not hear her, he did not move.
The Wenny King’s laughter rang out as he confronted the Great Dokkaebis.
[You’re too late. He belongs to the ‘Great Plotter’ now.]
At those words, the sky shook violently.
Tsssss!
A [Great Hole] was opening, incomparably larger than any before it.
The great demons on the river cowered at once. The fur coat of [Beast King’s Sensitivity] bristled like down.
She could feel it without being told. What was descending now could not be compared to <Emperor>’s constellations.
And Kim Dokja now belonged to that being.
“That won’t happen.”
[Tang Sanzang has chanted the ‘Headband-Tightening Incantation (緊箍咒)’!]
The moment Shin Yoosung activated the skill, the golden band on Kim Dokja’s head began shining.
[The item ‘Golden Headband (緊箍兒)’ responds!]
The Golden Headband was a treasure that restrained Sun Wukong.
All of Sun Wukong’s transformations—into a demon or anything else—temporarily stop while the incantation is recited.
[Foolish……!]

The Wenny King’s Status pressed down on Shin Yoosung’s entire body. She tasted blood deep in her mouth. The coat formed by [Beast King’s Sensitivity] fluttered wildly. Staggering, she approached Kim Dokja. Closer, and closer.
Kim Dokja’s battered face. His gaunt cheeks. Her sponsor, with his eyes quietly closed.
“Ajusshi!”
[Your new Story is germinating.]
There was still so much she wanted to say.
She would tell him about what had hurt her.
She would tell him he was a mess now.
For the first time, she would honestly tell him everything.
“Please, please listen to me!”
She would say she wanted everyone to go to an internet café together.
She would pester him to buy lots of pizza and cola and go to the Han River.
In a world where so much was now impossible, talking about impossible wishes
She would be happy.
Her vision shook, and tears flew ceaselessly.
At last, Shin Yoosung’s hand reached Kim Dokja’s fingertips.
A hand covered in wounds closed around another hand covered in wounds. It stung where wound touched wound. Even so, Shin Yoosung did not let go of that hand.
[You have acquired the Quasi-myth-grade Story ‘Saviour of a Star’!]
[The Story ‘Saviour of a Star’ begins its story.]
“There’s still so much I haven’t told you!”
The time she spent studying history with Sangah-unnie.
The time she spent cooking game with Joonghyuk-ajusshi.
Learning swordsmanship from Heewon-unnie.
Practicing skateboarding with Jihye-unnie.
Using Hyunsung-ajusshi as an airplane.
Eating ice cream with Lee Gilyoung while reading comics whose next volumes would never, ever come out.
“How much I……”
How she wished ajusshi had been there too.
“So many things……”
She cannot finish by saying she is not asking for much.
The world’s probability, the damned <Star Stream>, will not allow it.
“Just, normally……”
The stars in the sky were moving quickly.
Every star was looking at her, singing its own Story.
[Many audience members are watching you.]
In truth, she knows.
That an ordinary person’s ordinary happiness attracts no attention in this world.
And so, ordinary happiness.
Is the greatest luxury in a ruined world.
Even so
[Audience members pay a price to reveal their modifiers.]
[The constellation ‘Queen of the Darkest Spring’……]
[The constellation ‘Bald General of Justice’……]
Even so, if someone would listen to this story.
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’……]
[The constellation ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’……]
[The constellation ‘Goryeo’s First Sword’……]
As the indirect messages reached her one after another, Shin Yoosung gripped Kim Dokja’s hand harder.
Then one clear indirect message struck her ear.
[Judge ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ listens to your story.]
Warmth began returning to Kim Dokja’s hand.
A dazzling golden torrent erupted from Sun Wukong’s headband, followed by tremendous sparks of probability.
<Emperor>’s constellations shouted in horror.
[S-Surely not? That’s impossible……!]
Lightning-like currents gathered from across the sky toward Kim Dokja’s whole body.
[Judge ‘Bimawen’ listens to your story.]
(And at that moment.)
(Something happened that had never occurred in the history of Journey to the West.)
[Judge ‘Meihouwang’ listens to your story.]
(Retired Sun Wukong finally changed his mind.)
[Judge ‘Douzhanshengfo’ wishes to hear your next story.]
[Stage 3 of the exclusive skill ‘Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint’ is active!]
Dim consciousness. In the pitch-black darkness, the first things I heard were sentences coming through the [Fourth Wall].
「At that moment, Lee Jihye looked across the battlefield.」
Her battlefield was there.
Dozens of ships covering the Tongtian River.
The incarnations of <Emperor> preparing to fire, and the Historical-grade constellations in command.
「“Open fire!”」
<Emperor>’s warships surrounding the [Turtle Dragon] opened fire at once.
Lee Jihye advanced through the wreckage of ships. Taking some shots head-on and letting others slide past.
「“Load.”」
It was like an orchestral performance. Her command of warships had truly reached a sea god’s level as she maneuvered her [Turtle Dragon] and ghost fleet.
「“Fire.”」
Maritime Admiral Lee Jihye’s fleet opened fire. Reorganizing its formation to her commands, the ghost fleet repeated precise hit-and-run maneuvers, and the enemy fleet was devastated in an instant.
「“How is something this absurd……!”」
Command that overcame an overwhelming disadvantage. At last, the true worth of the ‘Maritime Admiral’, one of Ways of Survival’s strongest incarnations, was being revealed.
「[The constellation ‘Maritime War God’ is proud of his incarnation.]」
In the latter part of the original, Lee Jihye surpassed her sponsor.
Perhaps I would get to see that in this round as well.
「“Change tactics!”」

Apparently deciding this would not work, <Emperor>’s fleets charged at once. Ironclads led the assault. At a disadvantage in an artillery battle, they seemed to be forcing close combat. But there was something they did not know.
「“……Ah, I made this technique to give Dokja-ajusshi a good smack when I saw him.”」
Maritime Admiral Lee Jihye was good at close combat too.
Seeing her crouch into a sword-drawing stance, I realized what she intended to use.
「Instant Kill (瞬殺).」
Apparently, she had finally mastered one of the strongest anti-personnel skills in ‘Ways of Survival’.
Booooom!
Amid explosions piercing the gunwales, Lee Jihye’s close-quarters battle began. Cut, cut, and cut again. The sword demon’s blade crossed the water and sent an enemy commander’s head flying.
